meta.name: api-ai-elevenlabs
meta.description: ElevenLabs voice AI SDK patterns for TypeScript/Node.js -- text-to-speech, streaming, voice cloning, speech-to-speech, pronunciation control, and conversational AI

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 ElevenLabs 语音 AI 构建语音合成与克隆功能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要在 Node.js 项目里集成 ElevenLabs 语音能力
copy.tagline_en: Build text-to-speech and voice cloning with ElevenLabs AI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate ElevenLabs voice AI into your Node.js app

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能调用 ElevenLabs 语音 AI，将文字转为语音、流式播放、克隆声音、进行语音转语音转换，并构建对话式 AI 代理。
howto.when: 当你需要生成语音音频（如旁白、有声书）、实时流式播放、克隆声音或进行语音转换时触发。

say.text: 用 George 的声音把这段话转成 MP3。
流式播放这段文字，用 eleven_flash_v2_5 模型。
克隆这个音频样本，创建新声音。
say.note: 调用 voices.ivc.create 进行即时声音克隆。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use ElevenLabs voice AI to convert text to speech, stream audio, clone voices, perform speech-to-speech conversion, and build conversational AI agents.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to generate speech audio (e.g., narration, audiobooks), stream in real-time, clone voices, or convert speech.

say_en.text: Convert this text to MP3 using George's voice.
say_en.note: Calls textToSpeech.convert to generate a complete audio file.

say_en.text: Stream this text with the eleven_flash_v2_5 model.
say_en.note: Calls textToSpeech.stream for low-latency real-time playback.

say_en.text: Clone this audio sample to create a new voice.
say_en.note: Calls voices.ivc.create for instant voice cloning.
